body.p: Claims 2-21 are pending in the Application. Claims 9-21 are withdrawn from consideration. Claims 2-8 stand rejected. Applicant has amended claims 2, 3, and 5-8. Claims 22-33 are new. No new matter has been added. Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration and favorable action in this case.

Applicant thanks Examiner Woldemaryam for the indication that claims 3-8 would be allowable if rewritten to overcome the 112 rejections and rewritten to include all of the limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims. Applicant has amended claim 2 to overcome the 112 rejections. Applicant has also rewritten claims 3 and 5-8 in independent form, including the amendments to overcome the 1112 rejections of claim 2. An indication of allowance for all claims is respectfully requested. Double Patenting

Claim 2 stands rejected on the grounds of non-statutory double patenting over claim 19 of U.S. Patent 11,407,505. Without conceding the merits of this rejection, Applicant acknowledges this rejection and proposes to submit a terminal disclaimer if, once subject matter has been deemed otherwise allowable, such subject matter is obvious over any of the claims of U.S. Patent 11,407,505.

Claims 2-8 stand rejected as allegedly indefinite for failing to particularly point out and distinctly claim the subject matter which the inventor regards as the invention. Without conceding the merits o this rejection, Applicant has amended claim 2. With respect to claim 2, the Office indicates:

Line 5-6 of clam 2 recites "....each pitch change link configured to ride along the rotationally fixed swashplate...". It is not clear from the recitation of claim 2 how each pitch change links are riding along the rotationally fixed swashplate. If the swash plate is rotationally fixed how
is the pitch links riding along with it and in what direction?

Office Action at 4 (emphasis added). Applicant respectfully notes that original claim 2 stated that the pitch change links ride along the fixed swashplate, not along with the fixed swashplate. "Along" implies "with respect to," whereas "along with" implies "together with." Thus, original claim 2 clearly stated that the pith change links ride along or with respect to the fixed swashplate. In any case, Applicant has amended claim 2 for further clarification. Claim Rejections - 35 U.S.C. & 102

Claim 2 stands rejected as allegedly anticipated by GB Patent No. GB2457685 to Wain ("Wain"). Without conceding the merits of this rejection, and solely to expedite prosecution of this application, Applicant has amended independent claim 2 to clarify various differences over Wain.
Claim 2 has been amended to recite the features of:

the rotationally fixed swashplate comprising a plurality of movable rail members that together form a track along which the pitch change links ride, the rail members movable with respect to the rotationally fixed swashplate to form undulations on an upper surface of the track to change a pitch of at least one rotor blade connected to a respective pitch change link as the respective pitch change link rides
along the track.

Applicant respectfully submits that amended claim 2, as a whole, is patentable over Wain. For example, it has not been shown that Wain teaches or suggests a rotationally fixed swashplate that has movable rail members that together form a track along which the pitch change links ride as they rotate. Rather, Wain describes a swash plate that is flexible enough such that actuators can bend the swash plate to a desired shape. Wain at Abstract. Specifically, with respect to the movable rail members, the Office cites to "Fig. 1, upper swashplate, Fig. 2," and/or the last two paragraphs of pg. 5 of Wain. Office Action at 5-6. However, such figures do not teach or suggest movable rail members, and such sections simply describe a swashplate that is flexible to be movable by actuators, and do not teach or suggest a swashplate with movable rail members.

Accordingly, amended claim 2 is patentable over the cited references of record. For at least the foregoing reasons, Applicant respectfully requests allowance of amended claim 2 and all claims depending therefrom.

If the present Application is not allowed and/or if one or more of the rejections is maintained, Applicant hereby requests a telephone conference with the Examiner and further requests that the Examiner contact the undersigned attorney to schedule the telephone conference.

Applicant has made an earnest attempt to place this case in condition for allowance, and respectfully requests such a Notice. However, the absence of a reply to a specific rejection, issue, or comment does not signify agreement with or concession of that rejection, issue, or comment. In addition, because the arguments made above may not be exhaustive, there may be reasons for patentability of any or all pending claims (or other claims) that have not been expressed. Finally, nothing in this paper should be construed as an intent to concede any issue with regard to any claim, except as specifically stated in this paper, and the amendment of any claim does not necessarily signify concession of unpatentability of the claim prior to its amendment.
Applicant respectfully requests consideration of all filed IDSs not previously considered, by initialing and returning each Form PTO-1449.
The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge such fees or credit any overpayments to deposit account 06-1050, referencing the attorney docket number shown above.
Respectfully submitted,
